test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 2 men and 3 women can earn ₹49 in 7 days. 3 men and 6 women can earn ₹96 in 8 days. In what time 1 man and 1 woman earn ₹27?
solution:
**Given:**

2 men and 3 women earn ₹49 in 7 days

3 men and 6 women earn ₹96 in 8 days

Calculations:

Let the daily earnings of 1 man be ₹M and that of 1 woman be ₹W.

The equation for the earnings can be written as:

2 men + 3 women in 7 days earn ₹49

⇒ 7 × (2M + 3W) = 49

⇒ 2M + 3W = 7 ...... (i)

Similarly, 3 men + 6 women in 8 days earn ₹96
